finding_info.title: Phishing report: invoice-themed lure delivered to the AP team mailbox
finding_info.desc:
Opened by: SOC Tier 1 (d.lindqvist) from three user reports via the report-phish button.

Summary as reported: an email titled 'Overdue invoice 44817 — action required' reached the ap-team shared mailbox and two individual AP inboxes between 12:40 and 12:46 UTC. The link resolves to a page imitating the company sign-in portal. The mail gateway scored it clean. Sender domain was registered 2026-04-18.

Tier 1 triage notes:
- No click events found in the proxy logs for the three reporters.
- Mailbox search for the subject line pending.

Requested of Tier 2: confirm scope of delivery, check for any clicks or submitted credentials, and block the sender domain and URL if confirmed malicious.

Work notes:
2026-04-20 13:02 UTC d.lindqvist — Incident created, assigned to SOC Tier 2.
